description: This file contains functions for resolving account match priorities, matching configured bindings, converting conversation references, and resolving matching configured bindings within a plugin system for channels.

methods.name: resolveAccountMatchPriority
methods.description: Determines the priority of account match based on the provided match string and actual account ID.

methods.name: matchCompiledBindingConversation
methods.description: Matches an inbound conversation against a compiled configured binding rule.

methods.name: resolveCompiledBindingChannel
methods.description: Normalizes a raw channel string into a configured binding channel.

methods.name: toConfiguredBindingConversationRef
methods.description: Converts a ConversationRef object into a structured reference with channel, accountId, conversationId, and optional parentConversationId.

methods.name: materializeConfiguredBindingRecord
methods.description: Creates a binding record resolution from a rule, account ID, and conversation reference.

methods.name: resolveMatchingConfiguredBinding
methods.description: Finds the best matching configured binding rule for a given conversation among a list of rules.
